articles.title: Unlocking the Grand Canyon's Hidden Plumbing: 3D Cave Maps Reveal a Fragile Water Lifeline
articles.summary: Deep beneath the Grand Canyon, a network of caves feeds the springs that sustain millions of visitors and entire ecosystems. For the first time, scientists have created high-resolution 3D maps of over 10 kilometers of these passages. As the region grows hotter and drier, understanding this hidden plumbing is crucial.

articles.title: A Stellar 'Rosetta Stone': Astronomers Pinpoint the Source of Puzzling Cosmic Signals
articles.summary: Mysterious repeating radio signals from space have baffled astronomers for years. Now, an international team has traced one to a cataclysmic variable: a white dwarf and red dwarf in a tight 1.4-hour orbit. The discovery provides a crucial key for decoding other long-period radio transients across the Milky Way.

articles.title: From Hunter to Parasite: The Fly That Sacrifices Its Sight After Settling Down
articles.summary: The deer ked undergoes a dramatic lifestyle switch: it sheds its wings and becomes a permanent blood-feeder on a host. New research reveals that this transition is accompanied by a significant reduction in visual sensitivity, as the fly redirects energy to digestion and reproduction. It's a striking example of evolutionary trade-offs.
